t: Letters Regarding The Whereabouts Of Ezeril Alexander Edwards

pages.en:
C. & S. R.C.S.
No. S. D. 2149.
16 - 3 - 31.
Shanghai, China.

March 16, 31.

Mrs. E. M. Edwards,
No. 103-32nd street,
west saskatoon,
saskatoon, Canada.

Madam,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your
letter, dated February 6, 1931, regarding the
whereabouts of your husband Azeril Alexander
Edwards, and to inform you that he is not known
in Shanghai.

Your letter is returned herewith as
it is probably intended for Mexico.

I am, Madam,
Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches)

Encl:- 1.
16/3.

刑事与特别处 C. & S. R.C.S.
编号：S. D. 2149.
1931年3月16日。
中国，上海。

1931年3月16日。

埃德温娜·M·爱德华兹夫人（Mrs. E. M. Edwards），
加拿大，萨斯喀彻温省，
西萨斯卡通（west saskatoon），
第32街103号。

夫人：

本人谨确认收到您于1931年2月6日发出的来信，信中询问您丈夫阿泽里尔·亚历山大·爱德华兹（Azeril Alexander Edwards）的下落。现告知您，在上海无人知晓此人。

随信退回您的来函，因该信可能意在寄往墨西哥。

此致，
敬礼

副总监
（刑事与特别处）

附件：1件。
3月16日。

C O P Y.
----------
103-32 st. 7. Saskatoon
Sask

Feb. 6, 1931.

Chief of Police.

I have been trying to look my husband. I
don't want to ask for him in the papers as I don't
want people to know. So I heard once he was in Mexico
but don't know what port so I am writing you. And I want
you to try and hunt him up if he is in that State. And
let me know what he is doing. If you find him don't
let on to him that I want him but you write me and then
I will write him. He has been gone seven years and it is
hard on me making my own living. I think he is ashamed
after been gone so long and I hope he is well and I am
willing to meet him any place if he don't want to come
back to Canada. He is a man 5 ft 11 in tall he used
to weigh one hundred and sixty lbs, light blue eyes, medium
brown Hair. Slight dinge in his nose. He went by the
name of Alex Edwards here some called him Red. His real
his right name is Ezeril Alexander Edwards. His age is 50
next birthday his father was Irish, Mother Scotch. Now
I do hope you will find him as I am so anxious to hear
from him Mrs. Edwards his wife. I hope you will try
all over Mexico for him, if there isn't a police where
I am writing please send it on to one. Oblige

副本。
----------
萨斯喀彻温省，萨斯卡通，
第32街103-7号。

1931年2月6日。

警察局长：

我一直在寻找我的丈夫。我不想在报纸上刊登寻人启事，因为我不想让旁人知晓。我曾听说他在墨西哥，但不知具体是哪个港口城市，故致信于您。我希望您能设法在该州境内搜寻他，并告知我他的近况。如果您找到他，请不要向他透露是我在找他，请您先写信给我，然后我再写信给他。他已经离家七年了，我独自谋生很是艰难。我想他离家这么久一定感到羞愧，我希望他一切安好。如果他不愿返回加拿大，我愿意在任何地方与他见面。他身高5英尺11英寸，过去体重160磅，浅蓝色眼睛，中等棕色头发。鼻梁略有凹陷。他在此地使用亚历克斯·爱德华兹（Alex Edwards）之名，有些人叫他“雷德”（Red）。他的真名是埃泽里尔·亚历山大·爱德华兹（Ezeril Alexander Edwards）。下一个生日时他将满50岁。其父为爱尔兰人，其母为苏格兰人。现在我恳请您务必找到他，因为我迫切希望能得到他的消息。爱德华兹夫人，即其妻。希望您能在墨西哥各地代为寻找，如果我写信的地方没有警察局，请将其转交至最近的警察局。不胜感激
